subject: HelixHealth: EU-only processing evidence & SCCs operational path
messages:
From: Marc Dupont <marc.dupont@helixhealth.fr>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com, security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: EU-only processing - evidence and SCCs

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. We are running a regulatory review for our AI platform procurement and HelixHealth needs firm answers on a few items before legal signs off:

- Can Redwood commit to EU-only processing for HelixHealth (data-at-rest and model inference) under SCCs for the duration of the contract? We need the mechanism described (geofencing, routing, control plane locality).
- Operator access: please confirm operator roles, break-glass conditions, and whether you can provide an operator-access affidavit or a mapping to the SCCs sections referring to human access.
- KMS & key custody: do you support customer-managed keys for EU regions? If not, what controls exist to prevent plaintext key export?
- Backups & retention: retention windows, backup locations, and proof-of-deletion process when we request erasure.
- Evidence artifacts: a checklist of items Redwood can deliver (log extracts, audit trails, backup deletion receipts, SCCs mapping, DPA, SOC2 excerpts).

Can you confirm what you can provide within 10 business days and if you can supply a short operational plan / MAP for a pilot (artifact list + delivery timeline)?

We'd like to get a 30-min call booked this week with security + procurement if possible.

Best,
Marc
Marc Dupont
Head of Vendor Risk, HelixHealth
marc.dupont@helixhealth.fr

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-15T14:45:00+00:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing - evidence and SCCs

Hi Marc — thanks for the clear list. Short answers first, then proposed next steps.

Short answers (high level):
- EU-only processing: Yes — we can operate inference and customer data processing in EU-only compute clusters. We enforce routing via region-based routing policies and VPC peering for Private deployments. SCCs are used for the contractual transfer mechanism for any support interactions that require cross-border access.
- Operator access: limited-to-role, time-bound break-glass with documented approvals. We can provide an operator-access matrix and sampled access logs showing entitlements and approval traces.
- KMS: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (CMK) in EU regions for Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted customers we offer a bring-your-own-key path via Cloud KMS integrations (we will map specifics per cloud).
- Backups & deletion: backups are stored in-region for EU-only plans; retention windows default to 30 days for short-term snapshots unless contract says otherwise. We can provide deletion receipts + snapshot lifecycle logs on request.

What I'll attach now: an evidence checklist with the artifacts we can produce and an operator-access matrix that maps roles to SCCs sections. If you can highlight which artifacts are highest priority (e.g., access logs vs. backup deletion receipts), we'll prioritize those.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: confirm prioritized artifact list (you)
- Day 1–7: collect artifacts (evidence-checklist items) and internal sign-offs
- Day 8–14: provide packaged artifacts + reconciled SCCs mapping; propose short pilot in EU region if you want operational validation (pilot 2–4 weeks).

Would you / procurement like a 30-min slot Thurs or Fri (we have 9–11am CEST open)?

Thanks — attaching the checklist and matrix.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment(s): evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB), operator-access-matrix.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

On Sun, Aug 15, 2026 at 14:45 UTC, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Backups & deletion: backups are stored in-region for EU-only plans; retention windows default to 30 days for short-term snapshots unless contract says otherwise. We can provide deletion receipts + snapshot lifecycle logs on request.

Marc — a few technical clarifications from infra that will be helpful for your legal/security reviewers:

1) Backups: daily snapshots retained for 30 days (configurable). Long-term backups (archival) are not created by default for EU-only plans unless explicitly enabled in the contract; if HelixHealth requires 90/365-day archives we will enumerate locations and provide deletion workflows.

2) Deletion evidence: we can produce a time-stamped manifest of snapshot deletions and a corresponding entry in the audit log showing the deletion job id and operator request id. The manifest is hashed and we can provide the hash + log extract.

3) Operator access: operational break-glass currently requires two approvers (team lead + security) and is logged with why/when access issued. We can redact user ids for privacy but keep role/audit context.

4) CMK: when HelixHealth provides CMKs, keys remain in your Cloud KMS in-region; Redwood never exports raw key material. We can provide an architecture diagram for the CMK flow.

Suggested ask from Helix: please indicate (A) which artifacts are contractual must-haves vs nice-to-have, and (B) whether Helix wants a signed operator-affidavit (we have a template). With those we will start packaging this week.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Principal Product Manager, Platform Security
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
